sources.title: NSWEC Walcha by-election date and expenditure caps
sources.method: Official primary page directly read20November, corroborated by ordinary native HTTP200 at the exact URL without redirection.
sources.finding: The NSWEC schedule lists Walcha with a date of election of16January2027. The asterisk identifies one councillor position.

limits: The commission publishes the election date in its cap schedule. No detailed election timetable, candidate, result, formal poll notice or polling hours are inferred. The date-only countdown marks the start of16January in Sydney. Historical resignation and roster evidence retain their own dates.
